welcome.title: Read some Mandarin aloud
welcome.body: You'll read about 70 short cards out loud. It takes about 20 minutes. Find a quiet-ish spot.
consent.title: Before you start
consent.declined: No problem. Nothing was recorded. You can close this page.
background.title: Four quick questions
background.intro: All optional. Tap an answer, or leave it as is.
background.background.label: Mandarin is…
background.grew_up_hearing.label: You grew up hearing Mandarin mostly from
background.script.label: Which characters do you read?
background.reading.label: Show the cards in
mic.title: Microphone check
mic.body: Tap Allow microphone, then say a few words.
mic.checking: Say a few words in your normal voice. We're checking the sound level.
mic.level_low: A bit quiet. Hold the phone closer, or speak up a little.
mic.noisy: A little noisy. That's fine, or move somewhere quieter.
card.finish_early: Finish and send what I have
card.finish_early_confirm: Finish now? The cards you haven't read will be skipped.
pause.title: Paused
pause.body: Your recordings so far are saved on this phone.
done.title: All done. Thank you!
done.code_note: Keep this code if you ever want your recordings deleted.
done.delete_confirm: Delete your recordings from this phone? This can't be undone. Anything you already sent is kept.
done.delete_confirm_unsent: Delete your recordings from this phone? Nothing has been sent yet, so they will be gone for good.
share.fallback: Save the file, then send it
error.mic_blocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in Settings > Safari > Microphone, then try again.
error.unsupported: This browser can't record here. Please open the link in Safari on your iPhone.
error.storage: This browser can't save your progress, so please finish in one go.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please reload the page; your recordings so far are kept.
error.in_app_browser: This page can't record inside this app. Tap ⋯ (or the share button), choose Open in Safari, and carry on there.
